subject: Rallying participants for LumenWave technical demo — scheduling & procurement check
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@lumenwave.com>, ops@lumenwave.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SE-led technical demo + procurement/security attendees

Hi team,

Hope you're both well — quick request from the AE side. LumenWave (Maria + procurement lead Daniel Park) have greenlit a technical demo as the next step in the evaluation. They specifically asked for: SE-led walkthrough (inference runtime, private deployment options), a short Q&A with a security/ops person, and a procurement touchpoint to confirm contract timing.

Proposed windows (all ET):
- Tue May 4, 10:00–11:00
- Wed May 5, 14:00–15:00
- Thu May 6, 09:00–10:00

Can you confirm SE availability and who from infra/security we should include? I've attached a quick agenda (Agenda-v0.1.docx) and a first-pass attendee list.

Next steps: if one of the windows works, I can send a calendar invite and loop in procurement (Daniel) for any pre-demo legal/pre-reqs.

Thanks — Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@lumenwave.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SE-led technical demo + procurement/security attendees

Thanks Aditya — available to run this. Quick clarifying Qs so we scope the demo properly:
- Primary goals: are they evaluating latency/throughput, private VPC deployment, or cost/unit economics?
- Will they want a live inference run with their data (redacted) or synthetic examples?

If the ask is VPC/on-prem options + performance profile, I recommend a 45m demo + 15m security/procurement Q&A. I can cover the runtime, model selection, and fallback strategies. Priyom, can you confirm you can join as the engineering backup for deeper infra questions? Also, do we want to include a short pre-demo 15m sync with their security contact to cover evidentiary items (SOC2 excerpt, data flow diagram)?

I pulled together a one-page demo plan and uploaded it: Demo-plan.pdf (link below).

Proposed from my side: Tue May 4, 10:00 ET looks good. If procurement needs more lead time we'll move.

Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@lumenwave.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@lumenwave.com>, ops@lumenwave.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: SE-led technical demo + procurement/security attendees

Thanks, Aditya and Karthik — quick notes from LumenWave side:
- Procurement (Daniel) needs a 72-hour lead to clear contract terms; legal will want a short summary of data residency and retention policies beforehand.
- Security would like a SOC2 excerpt and a network architecture diagram ahead of the demo. We can do a pre-demo 20m call with security (Daniel + ops) to list required evidence.

Available windows on our end (ET):
- Mon May 3, 15:00–16:00
- Tue May 4, 10:00–11:00 (preferred)
- Wed May 5, 09:00–10:00

If Tue May 4 at 10:00 ET works, please send calendar invite and relevant artifacts. I have looped in Daniel and ops.

On the pre-demo security call: can you share the minimum artifact set we should bring? That will help us brief legal.

Best,
Maria

--
Maria Gonzalez
Director of Platform Engineering, LumenWave
maria.gonzalez@lumenwave.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@lumenwave.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SE-led technical demo + procurement/security attendees

Appreciate the context, Maria. I can join Tue May 4 10:00 ET and cover deployment/network questions and our AWS VPC peering options. For the pre-demo security sync, the usual minimum artifact set is:
- SOC2 excerpt (controls scope)
- High-level network diagram showing where data is processed/stored
- Data retention policy summary (how long tokens/logs retained)
- Contact for audit/log access (who to ping)

I'll attach a short note and a SOC2 excerpt we can share. If legal needs anything else we can follow up after the pre-demo sync.

Proposed:
- Pre-demo security sync: Mon May 3, 15:15 ET (15m)
- Full demo: Tue May 4, 10:00–11:00 ET (45m demo + 15m Q&A)

If that schedule looks good I can create invites and include a Google Drive with artifacts.

— Priyom
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@lumenwave.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@lumenwave.com>, ops@lumenwave.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SE-led technical demo + procurement/security attendees — confirmed

Thanks all — locking this in per availability.
Final schedule:
- Pre-demo security sync: Mon May 3, 15:15–15:30 ET (Google Meet)
- Demo: Tue May 4, 10:00–11:00 ET (45m demo + 15m Q&A)

I've created the calendar invites and attached the updated agenda (Agenda-v1.docx) and a SOC2 excerpt (SOC2-excerpt.pdf) to this thread for Daniel/legal to review. Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cDemoPlan

Admin asks for the LumenWave team: please confirm the attendee list for each meeting so we can include the right engineers and procurement contacts. We'll run the demo environment with synthetic examples unless you'd prefer to bring a redacted sample payload.

Next steps:
- Maria/Daniel: confirm attendees + any additional evidence requests by EOD Thu Apr 29
- Priyom/Karthik: prepare demo environment and a 3-slide quickstarts doc for the demo intro
- Aditya: will send invites and the hubspot deal link once attendees are confirmed

Appreciate the rapid coordination — see you next week.

Best,
Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
Attachments: SOC2-excerpt.pdf, Agenda-v1.docx
